pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Room & Co. is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A bright, freshly styled living room with plants and warm textiles

children: We started Room & Co. on a simple idea: good interior design shouldn’t be reserved for people building from scratch or writing big cheques. Most of us just want the room we already have to feel better.
So we do it online, for a flat fee — a real designer, a shoppable plan, and honest advice about what’s worth spending on and what isn’t. Friendly, fresh, and made for everyday homes.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You know the price before you start. No hourly billing, no scope creep, no invoice you didn’t see coming.
Everything’s on a shoppable board, so you can buy it all at once or spread it out over months.
We design around what you can actually spend, and we’ll always tell you where to save and where it’s worth it.
